label: Photographic (retro film, no people)
summary: Grainy retro film stills with no people: sunrise and sunset landscapes shot through leaves and flowers, ocean horizons, candles, roses, coffee, balloons, and quiet rooms.

label: Anime
summary: Loose painterly adult story illustration with visible oil-and-gouache strokes, distant staging, and warm sunset color rather than clean cel animation.
download: Put an anime SDXL checkpoint in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. Animagine XL or Illustrious XL are the usual picks, around 6.5 GB.

label: Illustrated monologue (storybook)
summary: Rough vintage relationship paintings with broad bristlework, distant environmental staging, warm sunset pigments, and readable loving, grieving, or solitary figures. Square 1:1 for blurred-fill framing.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Illustrious XL is preferred for concrete scene adherence; Animagine remains a tag-based fallback.

label: Illustrated monologue (living storybook)
summary: The distant rough-brush relationship-painting look, plus subtle breathing, drifting atmosphere, moving sunset light, and a restrained camera push.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Illustrious XL is preferred for concrete scene adherence; Animagine remains a tag-based fallback.

label: Flat vector
summary: Rough brush-shaped vector silhouettes, distressed screen-print texture, distant staging, and the shared warm sunset palette.
download: Works on any SDXL checkpoint, but needs a vector or flat-design LoRA in ComfyUI/models/loras to look right. Search Civitai for vector art or flat design SDXL LoRAs, usually 100 to 400 MB.

label: Ink line art
summary: Graphite, broken ink contours, broad dry-brush masses, restrained warm washes, and distant environmental storytelling.
download: Tested on RealVisXL and it still returns photographs. Needs an illustration checkpoint (Illustrious XL, Animagine XL, DreamShaper XL) or a lineart LoRA to actually draw.

label: FLUX.2 warm paper-comic (local first)
summary: Prompt-faithful layered paper-comic scenes with simplified figures, abstract graphic shapes, and one consistent warm-dark umber, charcoal, rust, ochre, beige and amber palette. Uses recurring character/material references, local FLUX.2 first, and Cloudflare only as configured fallback.
download: Install the official FLUX.2 Klein 4B BF16 diffusion model, Qwen 3 4B text encoder, and FLUX.2 VAE. BF16 is required on Apple Silicon because MPS cannot execute FP8 weights.

label: FLUX.2 warm paper-comic (Cloudflare)
summary: The same prompt-faithful warm-dark layered paper-comic treatment through Cloudflare Workers AI.
download: No model download. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in .env.

label: Animagine dark faceless storybook
summary: A concise Animagine preset for distant rough-brush story scenes in deep reds, warm gold, subtle greens, and sunrise/sunset light.

referencePrompts.prompt: safe, wordless material study, rough canvas and coarse paper, broad visible bristle strokes, dry-brush drag, palette-knife scumbling, broken charcoal marks, uneven matte oil and gouache pigment, deep burnt umber, brick red, rust, ember orange, ochre, muted golden yellow, restrained moss and olive green, deep teal, navy and near-black, sunrise sunset glow, amber rim light, aged grain, no person, no character, no face, no pose, no room, no landscape, no object, no composition to copy, no text, masterpiece, high score, great score, absurdres

label: Animagine lo-fi melancholy (Qwen-directed)
summary: Qwen invents varied cinematic scenes from each narration beat while Animagine keeps a fixed hand-drawn lo-fi anime contract: bold sketch lines, flat colors, heavy grain, rough paper, warm amber against deep teal/navy, and expansive negative space.

styleStudies.use: Approved dark solo composition, warm backlight, negative-space, and secrecy study; documented rather than injected.
Approved scene-variety study for rain, interior, station, market, and balcony compositions; documented rather than injected.
Approved vintage panel, paper, sepia-line, amber/umber, and restrained olive/teal style study; documented rather than injected.

label: Illustrious dark acrylic melancholy
summary: Illustrious renders a Qwen-directed cinematic scene with heavy acrylic impasto, broken ink contours, deep emerald/navy shadows, rust and amber light, canvas grain, and a frayed comic-paper finish.

label: Draw Things oil-and-gouache editorial
summary: The verified Draw Things recipe for restrained rough oil-and-gouache story scenes: Illustrious XL v2, the compatible textured-painterly LoRA at 65%, sane guidance, and native SDXL 16:9 generation.
download: Open Draw Things, select Illustrious-XL-v2.0 and Textured-Painterly-Style-Illustrious-v1, then leave the HTTP API enabled on port 7860.

label: FLUX.2 dark acrylic melancholy (local)
summary: FLUX.2 Klein renders the same Qwen-directed dark acrylic look through prompt conditioning only. The installed FLUX.1 painterly LoRA is intentionally not attached because it is a different architecture.
download: Uses the already installed FLUX.2 Klein 4B BF16 model, Qwen 3 4B text encoder, and FLUX.2 VAE.

label: Pixazo SDXL watercolor (free, experimental)
summary: Pixazo's free-preview Stable Diffusion XL Base 1.0 engine using the same warm-dark paper-watercolor prompt as FLUX. Useful as a zero-cost alternative, but controlled testing showed weaker medium, lighting, and atmosphere adherence than local FLUX even when the main objects were correct.
download: No local download. Set PIXAZO_API in .env. Pixazo currently documents this SDXL endpoint as free during preview with fair-use limits.

label: Google Gemini (cloud)
summary: Cloud-generated painterly editorial scenes using the shared distant rough-brush sunset palette. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY and billing.
download: No download. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in .env with image-generation quota enabled.

label: Simple (script-driven)
summary: Minimal, unopinionated prompt built mostly from the script's own words. No fixed shot plan, cast rule, or art direction: composition and style are left to the model's own reading of each line. Works with whatever SDXL checkpoint is already installed.
download: Works with any installed SDXL checkpoint; no download needed if another style already runs.

label: Illustrious warm paper-comic
summary: Illustrious tuned to the shared layered paper-comic look: simplified paper-cut figures, abstract graphic environments, matte ink, and a consistent warm-dark amber palette.
download: Best on Illustrious XL, which is installed. Any SDXL illustration checkpoint will run, but line weight and flat fills are cleanest on Illustrious.
